remarks: This one checks all the boxes! This updated 2 bed 1.5 bath condo features hardwood floors Throughout, built-in air conditioners, ample closet space, and a full private basement with in-unit laundry, and TONS of storage.  The well manicured exterior is perfect for enjoying time outside. Close to Merritt Parkway, Route 7, and train stations. Pets are allowed per the owner's discretion with $50 pet rent per month. Tenant pays 1st month rent in advance, 2 month security deposit at lease signing.
